rows.label: US citizens and residents abroad (expats): foreign earned income exclusion and expatriation tax [national]
rows.value: Worldwide income taxed; foreign earned income exclusion $132,900 for 2026 plus a housing exclusion above 16% of it; covered expatriates taxed on unrealized gains above $910,000. Paid by US citizens and resident aliens living abroad; covered expatriates. IRC sections 911, 877A.
